about: Refactoring scenarios over prometheus v3.15.0 (build/compare/prometheus). The caret is at indexOf(anchor) + at; anchor must be unique in the file. A selection is the exact unique substring 'select' (searched after indexOf(within) when 'within' is given). 'gopls' says what tools/compare/refactor/gopls_refactor.py asks gopls: rename at the caret, or a code action of one of 'kinds' over the caret / selection ('goplsAnchor' / 'goplsAt' / 'goplsSelect' move the gopls place where gopls works elsewhere, e.g. inline at a call site). null = gopls has no such refactoring; the code action list at the place is printed anyway.

scenarios.what: local variable
scenarios.expected: relabeledAlerts renamed at its declaration, both uses in `kept = append(kept, a)` and in `return kept`; nothing else changes.

scenarios.what: struct field used in other packages
scenarios.expected: Alert.GeneratorURL -> SourceURL in the declaration, the keyed literal and selector in notifier/alert.go, notifier/util.go, notifier/util_test.go, rules/manager.go, cmd/prometheus/main_test.go; the json tag `json:"generatorURL,omitempty"` must NOT change (wire format); the struct field block may need gofmt re-alignment.

scenarios.what: interface method with its implementations
scenarios.expected: alertmanager.url -> endpoint, the implementations alertmanagerLabels.url (alertmanager.go) and alertmanagerMock.url (manager_test.go), every am.url() call in alertmanagerset.go and the tests; the package net/url and local variables named url are untouched.

scenarios.what: type, with local variables of the same name around
scenarios.expected: type sendLoop -> alertSender in its declaration, receivers, `*sendLoop` in newSendLoop, `&sendLoop{`, `map[string]*sendLoop` (alertmanagerset.go, manager_test.go); the local variables named sendLoop (alertmanagerset.go:145,160, sendloop_test.go:63) and the function newSendLoop keep their names.

scenarios.what: package (clause; directory follows)
scenarios.expected: package clause kahansum -> kahan in util/kahansum/*.go, the directory util/kahansum -> util/kahan, the 4 importers (model/histogram/float_histogram.go, promql/engine.go, promql/functions.go, promql/functions_internal_test.go) get the new import path and the qualifier kahansum. -> kahan.

scenarios.what: file (and its test file)
scenarios.expected: notifier/util.go -> notifier/openapi.go; GoLand offers to rename util_test.go -> openapi_test.go as well; no text changes.

scenarios.what: local variable to a name that is taken in an inner scope
scenarios.expected: A conflict is reported: inside `for _, a := range alerts` the renamed lb would be shadowed by the loop variable a (lb.Reset(a.Labels) -> a.Reset(a.Labels)). Applying it anyway breaks the build.

scenarios.what: expression with two occurrences
scenarios.expected: `capacity := s.opts.QueueCapacity` before the first if of sendLoop.add, both occurrences in add replaced; compiles.

scenarios.what: string literal
scenarios.expected: `const resolvedSuffix = "[resolved]"` (local or package level) and `return s + resolvedSuffix`.

scenarios.what: statements with two results (a new variable and a reassigned parameter)
scenarios.expected: A method `(s *sendLoop) dropOverflow(alerts []*Alert) (int, []*Alert)` (or named results) and the call `dropped, alerts := s.dropOverflow(alerts)` (alerts reassigned, dropped new); the rest of add keeps using both; compiles.

scenarios.what: statements with `return nil, err` of the enclosing function inside
scenarios.expected: A function newClient(cfg) returning (*http.Client, error) (the early returns become `return nil, err` of the new function; `t` stays inside), the call `client, err := newClient(cfg)` + `if err != nil { return nil, err }` in newAlertmanagerSet; compiles. A tool that cannot handle returns refuses with a reason.

scenarios.what: statements using the receiver -> method
scenarios.expected: `func (s *sendLoop) deleteMetrics()` with the six statements, the call `s.deleteMetrics()` inside the closure of stop; compiles.

scenarios.what: string literal of a function body -> parameter
scenarios.expected: postPath(pre string, v config.AlertmanagerAPIVersion, format string); the body uses format; both calls (AlertmanagerFromGroup, alertmanager_test.go) pass "/api/%v/alerts"; compiles.

scenarios.what: local variable used once
scenarios.expected: `if err := config.CheckTargetAddress(model.LabelValue(lb.Get(model.AddressLabel))); err != nil {`, the declaration removed.

scenarios.what: one-statement method, caret on the declaration (all calls + delete)
scenarios.expected: The call in String becomes `if a.ResolvedAt(time.Now()) {`; the plugin (all calls) also deletes the method Resolved (exported: callers outside the repo break - GoLand asks); gopls inlines one call only.

scenarios.what: two-statement function, caret on one call
scenarios.expected: The call is replaced by the body: e.g. `lb.Set(pathLabel, path.Join("/", cfg.PathPrefix, fmt.Sprintf("/api/%v/alerts", string(cfg.APIVersion))))` (or with a temporary variable), imports fmt/path already present; postPath stays (used by the test).

scenarios.what: package-level constant used twice
scenarios.expected: Both uses become "__alerts_path__" and the declaration is deleted.

scenarios.what: add a parameter with a default value at the calls
scenarios.expected: func postPath(pre string, v config.AlertmanagerAPIVersion, root string) string; both calls pass "/"; compiles (root unused is fine for a parameter).

scenarios.what: remove a parameter that the body uses
scenarios.expected: A conflict: c is used in the body (`s.opts.Do(ctx, c, req)`); applied anyway, the call sites lose their second argument (sendloop.go, sendloop_test.go) and the body no longer compiles. gopls offers removeUnusedParam only for unused parameters.

scenarios.what: swap the first two parameters
scenarios.expected: newSendLoop(client *http.Client, alertmanagerURL string, ...); every call (alertmanagerset.go, manager_test.go, sendloop_test.go x6) swaps its first two arguments; compiles.

scenarios.what: add a result
scenarios.expected: nextBatch() ([]*Alert, int); the body's `return alerts` cannot be fixed automatically and the single-value calls (sendloop.go:177, sendloop_test.go) break: a correct tool reports the call sites (GoLand: conflict dialog / leaves them for the user).

scenarios.what: function to another file of the same package
scenarios.expected: labelsToOpenAPILabelSet moves to the end of alert.go; alert.go imports github.com/prometheus/alertmanager/api/v2/models; util.go keeps strfmt and models, drops labels (no longer used there); compiles.

scenarios.what: type with its method to a new file of the same package
scenarios.expected: notifier/amlabels.go (package notifier) gets the type and its url() method with imports net/url, github.com/prometheus/common/model, model/labels; alertmanager.go drops imports it no longer needs (net/url stays for the interface); compiles. gopls extract-to-new-file moves the selected declaration only and names the file itself.

scenarios.what: function to a new package (export + import)
scenarios.expected: New package notifier/openapi (labels.go) with exported LabelsToOpenAPILabelSet; util.go and util_test.go call openapi.LabelsToOpenAPILabelSet and import github.com/prometheus/prometheus/notifier/openapi; compiles, go vet passes.

scenarios.what: type implementing an unexported interface method to another package
scenarios.expected: A conflict / refusal: alertmanagerLabels satisfies the unexported interface alertmanager through the unexported method url(), which a type of another package cannot do; pathLabel is unexported too. Applied anyway, the build breaks.

scenarios.what: exported function used only by its test
scenarios.expected: A usage in strconv_test.go is reported (GoLand: 'usages found' dialog); deleting anyway keeps go build ./... green but breaks go vet ./util/strutil/ (the test).

scenarios.what: function used in production code
scenarios.expected: A conflict listing the usages (alertmanager.go AlertmanagerFromGroup, alertmanager_test.go); nothing is deleted unless forced.

scenarios.what: implement a project interface (unexported method, foreign import)
scenarios.expected: `func (s *sendLoop) url() *url.URL { panic("not implemented") }` (pointer receiver as the other methods) after the type's methods; sendloop.go imports net/url; compiles (the parameter named url in sendOne shadows the package only inside sendOne). gopls offers 'declare missing methods' only on a type error, not at the type.

scenarios.what: constructor of a struct with fields of other packages
scenarios.expected: func NewAlert(labels labels.Labels, ...) *Alert with all five fields; a parameter named labels would shadow the package labels in the parameter list (`labels labels.Labels` compiles, but a second `annotations labels.Labels` after it does not) - a correct generator picks non-shadowing names; compiles.

scenarios.what: getters and setters of a struct with unexported fields
scenarios.expected: Cfg()/SetCfg(...) etc. for every field (GoLand: Getter and Setter dialog with the fields ticked); the copied sync.RWMutex getter returns a copy of a lock (go vet copylocks warns). Compiles.

scenarios.what: String() of a struct
scenarios.expected: func (o Options) String() string (or pointer receiver) with fmt.Sprintf over the fields; manager.go already imports fmt; compiles.

scenarios.what: expression of a method -> struct field initialized in the method
scenarios.expected: A field `timeout time.Duration` in sendLoop, `s.timeout = time.Duration(s.cfg.Timeout)` before the WithTimeout line, the call uses s.timeout; compiles.

scenarios.what: if / else if chain -> switch
scenarios.expected: switch { case a.Ts < b.Ts: return -1; case a.Ts > b.Ts: return 1 } with the rest untouched; compiles.

scenarios.what: switch with a default -> if / else
scenarios.expected: if s.cfg.APIVersion == config.AlertmanagerAPIVersionV2 { ... } else { ... }; compiles.

scenarios.what: var declaration without a value -> short variable declaration
scenarios.expected: `dropped := 0` if offered (GoLand: 'Convert to short var declaration' may need an initializer); compiles either way.

scenarios.what: short variable declaration -> var declaration with the type
scenarios.expected: `var lb *labels.Builder = labels.NewBuilder(labels.EmptyLabels())` (or `var lb = ...`); compiles.
